evals.prompt: A team member says: 'We need to let external contractors submit timesheets without Desk access'. Which part of the Frappe skill set handles this and in what order should we proceed?
evals.expected_output: A routing decision identifying the relevant lifecycle skills in order, with brief rationale for each
expectations: Identifies frappe-web-forms as the skill for public/no-Desk data collection
Mentions checking frappe-project-triage before making changes to an existing codebase
Routes through a logical BUILD-phase skill (e.g. frappe-doctype-development for the Timesheet model) if the DocType does not yet exist
Does not start implementing; only routes and explains the sequence

evals.prompt: I want to expose real-time stock levels to a third-party dashboard. I'm not sure whether to build an API, use a webhook, or build a Vue frontend. Help me pick the right path.
evals.expected_output: A routing decision with the primary skill and explanation of when to escalate to a secondary skill
expectations: Identifies frappe-api-development as the primary skill for exposing business logic over HTTP
Distinguishes between push (webhook) and pull (whitelisted endpoint) scenarios and names the appropriate reference
Mentions frappe-frontend-development only if a Vue SPA is chosen as the delivery surface
Does not combine all three paths; makes a recommendation based on the stated need
